concept: Midday memorial courtyard with pigeons and shrine figures
creativeDirection: Daylight location photography in a real old memorial courtyard, using the covers' symbolic figures and graphic motifs as physically staged objects and fixed portraits within one crisp, sunlit scene.
scene: An outdoor stone memorial courtyard beside an old mausoleum and high-rise apartments, seen in a wide 16:9 view from slightly below eye level so the architecture, shrine structure, and sky all read clearly. The setting combines a weathered urban cemetery garden with a bright open paved space, allowing one dominant central shrine-like structure and a clear flock of birds overhead.

elements.element: a large flock of pigeons flying across the pale sky above modern apartment towers with repeating balconies at the edge of the location
the horse-and-rider motif transformed into a small painted folk icon mounted on the shrine structure
the four people from reference image 3 standing together facing camera, kept close as a distinct group and strongly backlit by a bright white opening behind them inside the mausoleum entrance
the woman from reference image 4 crouching barefoot inside a small wooden box placed prominently in the courtyard, with the small blue object beside her
the man from reference image 5 standing bowed beside a weathered stone cross in the left foreground near broken slabs

the floating child with a large round balloon reimagined as a painted festival balloon sculpture suspended above the courtyard, with small colorful gathered decorative details on fabric, tiles, and objects around the scene
a tall glowing window with sheer curtains in the mausoleum wall, plus the long-haired person from reference image 7 bending forward in shadow inside that interior opening
an ornate black-and-gold arch built as the central shrine facade, with sunburst rays and two sculpted reclining lions at its base

coverSummaries.description: A photograph of many pigeons flying across a pale overcast sky above modern high-rise apartment buildings with repeating balconies. The buildings rise from the lower left and lower center, while blurred branches or foliage appear in the lower right foreground. The composition emphasizes motion in the flock against the stark urban backdrop.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a flock of pigeons in flight

coverSummaries.description: A mostly empty cream background with a small centered image resembling a medieval or folk-style painting. The inset artwork shows a stylized rider on a white horse holding a long spear or staff, with bold outlines and flat areas of red, black, yellow, and white. The small square image sits isolated in the middle of the cover.

A black-and-white photograph of four people standing close together against a dark background with a bright glowing, smoky shape behind them. The figures are lit from behind, creating halos around their hair and shoulders. Three appear feminine-presenting and one masculine-presenting, with varied hairstyles and dark clothing, posed facing the camera.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: four backlit band members before a bright smoky glow
coverSummaries.people: four people standing together, strongly backlit, facing the camera

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist cover with a large white field and a small square photograph near the center. Inside the square, a barefoot woman with long curly hair crouches inside a wooden box-like space, one hand braced on each side. A small blue object sits beside her on the floor of the box. Across the top are large blocky wooden forms spanning the width.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a woman crouching inside a small wooden box
coverSummaries.medium: mixed media with photograph and graphic elements
coverSummaries.people: one woman crouching barefoot inside a box

coverSummaries.description: A moody outdoor photograph set in a graveyard or memorial garden. A solitary man in a long dark coat stands with head bowed beside a weathered stone cross. Behind him is an old domed mausoleum or pavilion with columns and peeling surfaces, while the ground and trees are tinted with intense red foliage and grass. Broken stone slabs lie nearby.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a bowed man beside a stone cross
coverSummaries.people: one man in a long dark coat standing with head bowed

coverSummaries.album: Around the World in a Day
coverSummaries.description: A colorful illustrated scene with many stylized figures gathered around a poolside or terrace under a blue sky with clouds and white birds. A child-like figure floats holding a round balloon-like sign, while other figures sit, stand, play instruments, or pose in patterned clothing and draped garments. The background includes a multicolored abstract wall or hill and scattered confetti-like details.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a floating child holding a large round balloon
coverSummaries.people: many illustrated figures gathered in a surreal outdoor scene

coverSummaries.description: A dim, hazy interior photograph centered on a tall window with sheer curtains glowing from daylight behind them. In the lower right area, a long-haired person bends forward with head lowered, partially obscured by shadow and soft blur. The room has worn walls and a muted, dreamlike atmosphere with layered reflections or light leaks.
coverSummaries.people: one long-haired person bending forward indoors

coverSummaries.album: Gods own medicine Limited MMXXVI MWIS Edition
coverSummaries.description: An ornate graphic illustration on a dark marbled background. At the center stands a robed female figure with arms outstretched beneath a decorative arch, with radiating sun-like lines around her head. Two banner-like shapes flank the arch, and two reclining lions sit symmetrically at the base. The design is rendered in gold and black with strong symmetry.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: a robed woman beneath an ornate arch with a sunburst halo

prompt: A wide outdoor memorial courtyard beside an old domed mausoleum and nearby modern apartment towers, photographed in crisp hard midday sun from slightly below eye level, with open sky filling the upper half of the frame; at the center stands a real black-and-gold ornate shrine arch inspired by reference image 8, built into the courtyard with radiating sunburst detail and two reclining lion sculptures at its base, while the woman from reference image 4 crouches barefoot inside a small wooden box placed prominently in front of it with the small blue object beside her; the man from reference image 5 stands bowed beside a weathered stone cross and broken stone slabs in the left foreground, the four people from reference image 3 stand close together facing the camera inside the mausoleum entrance behind the shrine with a bright white backlit opening creating a halo around them, and the long-haired person from reference image 7 bends forward inside a tall glowing curtained window in the mausoleum wall off to one side; overhead, a large flock of pigeons from reference image 1 crosses the pale sky above repeating-balcony apartment buildings, and the stylized horse-and-rider from reference image 2 appears as a small painted folk icon mounted on the shrine, while the floating child holding a round balloon from reference image 6 is transformed into a suspended festival sculpture above the courtyard with subtle colorful patterned drapery and small decorative objects echoing that source around the edges; daylight location photography, physically plausible and sharply rendered, with clear facial recognisability for the people, strong architectural depth, clean textures, and no haze or rain; balanced composition with the shrine and box as the main focal point, bowed man and stone cross anchoring the left, glowing mausoleum portraits as secondary focal points, pigeons and towers completing the upper background; palette of sunlit stone grey, cream, white, gold, black, muted red accents, and sky blue, creating a bright ceremonial urban-sacred mood. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 3 shows four people standing together, strongly backlit, facing the camera; reference image 4 shows one woman crouching barefoot inside a box; reference image 5 shows one man in a long dark coat standing with head bowed; reference image 6 shows many illustrated figures gathered in a surreal outdoor scene; reference image 7 shows one long-haired person bending forward indoors. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image brightly and cleanly: open, readable shadows and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
